title: dev 部署 release-artifacts 保留期限＋build cache 上限＋磁碟預檢
summary: Implements pre-build release-artifact retention in scripts/dev_release_artifact_retention.py, bounds Docker builder cache by default via docker builder prune -f --keep-storage 20GB while keeping unused-image prune opt-in behind PANTHEON_DEV_DOCKER_PRUNE=true, enforces a 25GB free-disk preflight floor on the deploy filesystem before the dev root build, and documents the policy in docs/deployment/vm-dev-staging-prod-management-plan.md.

acceptance_verification.description: Before the dev root build and while holding the dev environment lease, the deploy applies a retention policy to pantheon-ci-deploy/release-artifacts: it keeps every image archive, compose bundle, and baseline folder referenced by the currently served release, the last 3 accepted releases, the in-flight candidate, and the latest captured rollback baseline; all other entries are deleted and the deleted count and bytes are logged.

Retention never deletes a file referenced by any kept manifest even when archives are shared between releases; a test builds a fixture root with kept and stale manifests and shared archives and proves only unreferenced files are removed and a dry-run mode deletes nothing.

Docker build cache is bounded by default with docker builder prune --keep-storage (configurable and default 20GB) while the unused-image prune stays opt-in behind PANTHEON_DEV_DOCKER_PRUNE because rollback needs prior images.

After retention and the cache bound, a disk preflight fails the deploy before any build with an explicit insufficient-disk message when free space on the deploy filesystem is below a configurable floor (default 25GB).
docs/deployment/vm-dev-staging-prod-management-plan.md documents the retention rule, the cache bound, and the disk floor; existing release-artifact and restore tests stay green.
